name: rmsnorm Phase-1a SoS-gather deep prefetch (P=4, scalar not float4)
kernel: kernels/src/fused_rmsnorm_mq_rotate.hip (Phase-1a lines 64-72), + _plain.hip (59-65, a3b mq4r live path), + _awq.hip (53-59, mq4p default)
change: Unroll the stride-256 scalar SoS gather 4-wide: issue 4 outstanding global loads (i, i+256, i+512, i+768) before consuming any, then consume in ascending-i order into the SINGLE accumulator. Keep it scalar (NOT float4 - that reorders the reduction). K is a multiple of 256; for K/256 not div-by-4 add a remainder path that guards BOTH the OOB global load AND the x_shared[i>=K] LDS store (an unguarded store clobbers reduce[]=smem+K). Common K (4096->16 groups, 12288->48) is div-by-4, remainder path not taken.
precheck: none (byte-identical by construction). Optional confidence: gfx-kernel-metadata on .hsaco to confirm VGPR ~48->~52 (nowhere near spill) and that 4 global_loads issue before the first consume (proves MLP=4 landed, not re-serialized).
coherence_check: Hard token-id parity: HIPFIRE_DETERMINISTIC=1, FP32 state, temp0, HIPFIRE_EMIT_TOKEN_IDS=1 - committed token-id stream must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to baseline. coherence-gate.sh is a formality. A parity diff = implementation bug, fix before landing (never ships as regression).
certify_protocol: Isolate decode window: dwall=tokens/decode_tok_s, sample only the LAST dwall seconds of GPU-busy (whole-run median is ~35% load/gap garbage). Adaptive-resample median-of-5, fresh process per measure, byte-identical prompt (record md5), gpu-lock coordinated. Floor: delta must hold >=+1% across reruns to clear the gfx11 +/-1-3% + ~30% DPM-VOID band; correctness does NOT depend on the noisy tok/s (parity gate is independent).
realistic_delta: +1.2-1.6% (wall 6.5%; occ 0.1% is STRUCTURAL - single 8-wave block on one CU, no sibling waves, so P=4 prefetch is the ONLY latency lever and is guaranteed to land). Safest highest-value byte-exact lever, STACK member #1.
kill_condition: Token-id parity FAILS and cannot be made identical -> abandon (not a correctness-preserving transform). If parity passes but certified median is <= +0.3% and holds across reruns -> compiler was already pipelining; record no-op, close.

name: MoE-down branch-free tail restructure (stage ALL guarded loads then ALL computes, MLP 1->2)
change: a3b moe_intermediate=512 -> down K=512 -> groups=2, quads=0, tail=2, so the guarded TAIL is 100% of the kernel. Currently the tail is load->compute per guard (serialized MLP=1). Restructure: stage BOTH guarded weight loads (keep the tail>=1 / tail>=2 in-bounds address guards on the LOADS) first, THEN both DOG computes into independent acc0/acc1. Final reduce (acc0+acc1)+(acc2+acc3) untouched (acc2=acc3=0). Scalarize sc/zp to SGPR; only 2-3 pk staged.
precheck: DECISIVE ISA disasm (gfx-kernel-metadata / llvm-objdump on gfx1100 .hsaco): confirm current tail's two weight global_loads are serialized by an intervening s_waitcnt+ALU (MLP=1); confirm restructured kernel issues both global_loads before the first waitcnt (MLP=2). If current is ALREADY dual-issued -> the change is a no-op, do not certify. NAMED: restructured VGPR <=96 (target <=91, 88->~91 stays in the 96-bucket -> 16 waves preserved), zero new spills.
coherence_check: Hard token-id parity (HIPFIRE_DETERMINISTIC=1/FP32/temp0/EMIT_TOKEN_IDS identical). acc0/acc1 independent + staging reorders only independent ops (no FP reassociation) -> byte-exact.
certify_protocol: Only in the STACKED gfx11 certify (not solo - solo delta is below the floor). Isolate decode window (last dwall s), adaptive median-of-5, fresh process, prompt md5. Attributable delta measured as the stack increment over member-#1-only baseline.
realistic_delta: +0.4-0.7% honest (down_k8 = 7.6% wall, mem 51%, already ~13-16 resident waves giving TLP; kernel MLP 1->2 ~= +5-10% kernel-local -> Amdahl to <1% E2E). Pool +1-2% is optimistic. STACK member #2.
kill_condition: ISA precheck shows the two tail loads are ALREADY hoisted/dual-issued -> CUT (pure no-op). OR restructured VGPR spills / exceeds 96 dropping below 16 waves -> CUT (becomes the row-reuse -occ failure mode).
ready: certify-now / byte-EXACT, gated on the decisive ISA precheck. Stack member #2.

name: Attention Phase-A KV register-ring prefetch P=4 (P independent accumulators, per-token shfl trees)
change: Phase A has NO cross-token accumulation: each scores[t_local] is an independent reduction (partial re-zeroed per token, fixed half-order 4-term FMA, own 16->8->4->2->1 butterfly, non-aliasing store). Strip-mine by P=4: preload 4 K-blocks (consecutive tokens 544B apart = 4 independent cachelines) into a register ring, run 4 independent partial accumulators, then 4 deferred __shfl_xor/ds_swizzle butterflies in token order. Copy the 4-term FMA expression VERBATIM (identical -ffp-contract=fast lowering). Hoist window-mask as a contiguous prefix, ring the valid suffix, per-token individual mask, scalar tail for tile_len%4.
precheck: DISPOSITIVE ISA disasm (gfx-kernel-metadata on gfx1100 .hsaco): confirm all 4 kb0..kb3 global_loads issue before the first v_fma_f32/ds_swizzle in the Phase-A hot loop (proves MLP=4, defeats the shfl/swizzle early-consumption re-serialization trap), 0 VGPR/SGPR spills, VGPR ~64->~76 (occ is grid-structural at 0.5%, not register-limited -> extra VGPR is free, no occupancy-boundary cross).
coherence_check: Token-id parity (HIPFIRE_DETERMINISTIC=1/FP32/temp0/EMIT_TOKEN_IDS) must be identical - byte-exact by construction since Phase A has no cross-token accumulation. MANDATORY backstop (softmax-downstream): coherence-gate.sh + attractor probe (5% score drift -> attractor in ~10 tokens).
certify_protocol: Only after the ISA precheck passes (else GPU time measures noise~0). Isolate decode window (last dwall s), adaptive median-of-5, fresh process, prompt md5. Attention is 8.2% wall / Phase-A ~3.7% -> hard cap +3.8%.
realistic_delta: +1.3-1.8% (biggest structural bite: MLP 1->4 on a genuine serial-per-token loop at the worst-occupancy kernel). Pool +3-5% is physically impossible (infinite-speedup cap on 3.7% wall = +3.8%). STACK member #3.
kill_condition: ISA precheck shows loads re-serialize before the first FMA/swizzle (compiler defeated the ring), OR spills appear, OR VGPR crosses an occ boundary -> CUT. If precheck passes but certified stack-increment is ~0 -> mechanism landed but Amdahl swallowed it; record and close.
ready: certify-now / byte-EXACT (spec, must be implemented+ISA-prechecked before GPU). Stack member #3.

name: Attention Phase-D V register-ring prefetch P=4
change: Preload P=4 tokens' V blocks into a register ring, accumulate out0..out3 in token order, then combine. This is a LOAD-TIMING transform (when V loads issue), NOT an unroll-width change - distinct from the failed V-unroll 8->6 (-2.77%), which changed accumulation width. Additive with order-3 (same kernel, different phase). Copy the accumulate expression verbatim.
precheck: ISA disasm (gfx-kernel-metadata): confirm 4 V global_loads issue before the first accumulate consume (MLP=4 landed), 0 spills, VGPR stays in the grid-structural-free band (occ 0.5%). If Phase-D reduction order must change to ring it -> re-verify token-order accumulation is preserved.
coherence_check: Token-id parity identical + coherence-gate.sh + attractor probe (softmax-downstream, same backstop as order-3).
certify_protocol: Certify as an increment ON TOP of order-3 (same attention kernel - measure combined attention delta, don't double-count wall). Isolate decode window, adaptive median-of-5, fresh process, prompt md5.
realistic_delta: +1.5-3% claimed but shares the 8.2% attention wall with order-3; combined attention Phase-A+D realistic ceiling ~+2-3% E2E, not additive-independent. Honest marginal over order-3: +0.5-1.2%.
kill_condition: Parity fails, OR ISA shows re-serialization/spills, OR combined attention delta does not exceed order-3-alone within the floor -> abandon Phase-D (keep Phase-A).
ready: certify-now / byte-EXACT, gated on ISA precheck. Additive follow-on to order-3.

kernel: kernels/src/gemv_hfq4g256_moe_down_k8_indexed_batched_expanded.hip residual path (and residual add sites); GemvResidual family
change: Same branch-free tail-staging pattern as order-2 applied to the residual-GEMV: stage guarded loads then computes to lift MLP=1->2 on the tail, independent accumulators, final reduce order untouched. residual = 5.4% wall, mem 48%, latency-bound.
precheck: ISA disasm: confirm current residual tail loads are serialized (MLP=1) and the restructure dual-issues them; VGPR (72->~76) stays >=16-wave bucket, zero spills. If already hoisted -> CUT.

name: gfx12 qkvza R=2 multirow (2 rows/WG, shared x across all 4 matrices, route each row independently)
kernel: kernels/src/fused_qkvza_hfq4g256.hip -> new symbol ..._r2 (DISTINCT module name per JIT cache-collision rule)
change: Process 2 adjacent output rows per workgroup. x is shared across ALL 4 fused matrices (Q/K/V/za) -> cleanest x-hoist; load x_row once, run 2 independent weight streams (doubles in-flight weight-load MLP), route each row's write independently. Same inner FMA order + same acc[gi] tail interleaving per row -> byte-exact. Wire via existing (func,block,grid_div) tuple, grid_div=2, gate is_rdna4()&&gemv_rows_default()>1. Opt-in HIPFIRE_GEMV_ROWS until certified. A/B R=4 (72->~150 VGPR ~8 waves) as a follow-up only.
precheck: gfx-kernel-metadata on gfx1201 .hsaco: VGPR 72->~96-104 (MORE headroom than gate_up which starts at 96), <=128, ZERO spill, >=12 waves/CU. Relax __launch_bounds__ to (32,12) as needed. Spill>128 -> caught offline before any GPU time.
coherence_check: MANDATORY A3B coherence gate (load-bearing: memory records HIPFIRE_GEMV_ROWS=1 on gfx1201 A3B mq4r = garbage, so the multirow path is coherence-sensitive on this exact arch/model). Token-id parity + attractor probe.
certify_protocol: On hiptrx/gfx1201, SEPARATE box from gfx11 primary. Measure ABSOLUTE tok/s at perf_level=AUTO not high (high UNDER-CLOCKS R9700 ~13%). Capture sclk (pp_dpm_sclk *), VOID any clock-mismatch run. Isolate decode window, adaptive median-of-5, fresh process, prompt md5.
realistic_delta: gfx12 kernel -8..-15%, +1.5-2.5% E2E (qkvza=11.7% wall, highest gfx12 wall + most VGPR headroom + cleanest shared-x). Proven R=2 class on gfx12 (moe_down+residual +4.24% shipped, lm_head R=2 default). gfx12 latency-bound (640GB/s/64CU) so extra MLP outweighs occ drop; gfx11 REGRESSED -2% (BW-sat) -> R=2 stays gfx12-only.
kill_condition: No no-spill variant compiles <=128 VGPR -> CUT. Certified median at AUTO clock does not clear the gfx1201 noise band -> no-op. A3B coherence gate fails / attractor -> abandon (never ship the garbage-path).
ready: certify-now / byte-EXACT, gated on offline VGPR precheck. Top gfx12 lever (SHIP).

name: gfx12 gate_up R=2 multirow (2 rows/WG, hoist shared x_row once, 2 weight streams)
change: 2 adjacent rows/WG, shared x_row hoisted once, 2 independent weight streams, per-row masked gate/up write-split. Same FMA order + acc[gi] tail interleaving -> byte-exact. Ship in one gfx12 multirow-MoE patch with order-6 (qkvza-R2) + moe_down-R2. If full x-hoist pushes VGPR >128, drop the full hoist and keep only the 2 weight streams.
precheck: gfx-kernel-metadata on BOTH variants (full-x-hoist AND reduced-hoist): VGPR <=128, zero spill. gate_up R=1 is ALREADY at 96 VGPR (16-wave ceiling, NO headroom) -> R=2 lands ~120-128 = 12 waves = ~25% occ loss. Advance ONLY the lowest-VGPR no-spill variant (prefer <=~110 / >=14 waves). If the only no-spill variant is pinned 120-128/12-waves, the occ-vs-MLP bet is too thin for +1.5-3% -> DROP rather than certify.
coherence_check: MANDATORY A3B coherence gate + token-id parity + attractor probe (same gfx1201 A3B mq4r garbage-path sensitivity).
certify_protocol: gfx1201, perf_level=AUTO, capture sclk, VOID clock-mismatch. Isolate decode window, adaptive median-of-5, fresh process, prompt md5.
realistic_delta: gfx12 kernel -10..-18%, +1.5-3% E2E - BUT the +4.24% moe_down precedent won specifically at 96 VGPR/16 waves (zero occ loss); gate_up starts pinned at the ceiling so R=2 pays a 16->12 wave penalty the precedent did NOT. Can flip to no-op/regression.
kill_condition: Only no-spill variant is 120-128 VGPR/12 waves AND certified median <= baseline -> the occ loss ate the MLP gain, DROP. Nothing compiles no-spill <=128 -> CUT. Coherence fail -> abandon.
ready: certify-now / byte-EXACT, gated on the two-variant VGPR precheck (HOLD - occ headroom is the crux).

name: gfx12 NT (non-temporal) loads on stream-once expert weights (pk/sc/zp only; x/KV stay temporal)
kernel: kernels/src/gemv_hfq4g256_moe_gate_up_indexed_batched.hip + ..._moe_down..._expanded.hip; WLD_U32 macro + dual-emit _nt func from ONE module (avoid module-name JIT cache collision)
arch: gfx12 ONLY (SKIP gfx11: 96MB MALL + 6MB L2, reused set tiny -> no lever)
change: __builtin_nontemporal_load (SLC hint) on the read-ONCE expert weight streams (pk/sc/zp). x_row/rot_batch are reused across M rows -> MUST stay temporal. Mechanism is second-order: the MoE kernels' own loads gain ~nothing (read-once), but marking ~24MB/token of streaming expert weights non-temporal can stop them evicting the reused DENSE weights + KV from the 64MB gfx12 MALL. Gate HIPFIRE_GFX12_NT_WEIGHTS opt-in.
precheck: DISPOSITIVE profile_standard GL2C_HIT counter-ratio diff on gfx1201 (a RATIO, valid under DPM clock gating), byte-identical prompt (md5), NT-off vs NT-on: the DENSE gate_up/down + attention/KV kernels' hit-ratio must RISE clearly above counter noise. Measuring the MoE streaming kernels' OWN hit-ratio is a mismeasurement trap - the mechanism protects OTHER kernels. Flat dense/KV hit-ratio -> MALL wasn't evicting the reused set -> no lever -> CUT before any tok/s certify.
coherence_check: Byte-EXACT (SLC/NT changes cache policy, not bits) -> coherence gate passes trivially; run token-id parity as formality.
certify_protocol: Run a 2x2 scope matrix (MoE-NT x Dense-NT); drop any cell that regresses effective latency (sign uncertain). Only if the GL2C_HIT precheck confirms the mechanism AND the 2x2 is non-negative: warm fresh-process adaptive-resampled tok/s median on gfx1201 at AUTO clock, must clear the arch noise band. Isolate decode window, prompt md5.
realistic_delta: gfx12 +0 to +2% if MALL eviction of reused x/KV is real; ~0 if dense set already ~100% MALL-hit. Cheapest orthogonal probe; does NOT advance the gfx11-primary axis. Below the R=2 trio.
kill_condition: GL2C_HIT on dense/KV kernels is flat NT-off vs NT-on -> MALL wasn't thrashing -> CUT (no mechanism). Any 2x2 cell regresses -> drop that cell; all regress -> abandon.
ready: sign-uncertain / byte-EXACT, gated on the free GL2C_HIT mechanism precheck (HOLD). gfx12 secondary probe, lowest priority.
